package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"
)

const (
	// TeacherTurnContractSchema is the S0 contract. It is deliberately a
	// domain-only contract; cursor persistence and worker wiring belong to S1.
	TeacherTurnContractSchema = "teacher-turn-s0.v1"
	TeacherTurnLLMBoundary    = "ai-prompt"

	TeacherActionReceiptEvidenceSchema = "canonical-student-turn-interaction.v1"
	TeacherActionReceiptEvidenceKind   = "teacher_action_receipt"
	MaxTeacherActionReceiptOpaqueIDLen = 128
	TeacherActionReceiptDigestHexLen   = 64
)

var (
	ErrInvalidTeacherTurnContract = errors.New("invalid teacher turn contract")
	ErrTeacherTurnOutOfOrder      = errors.New("teacher turn is out of order")
	ErrTeacherTurnCursorBlocked   = errors.New("teacher turn cursor cannot advance")
	ErrDuplicateTeacherReply      = errors.New("duplicate teacher reply")
	ErrMultipleStudentTransitions = errors.New("multiple student transitions for one turn")
)

// TeacherActionReceiptEvidence is the exact action evidence Dialog accepts on
// the reserved trusted canonical-turn boundary. It is contract-only in S0:
// Teacher validates the evidence and no runtime materialization is enabled.
type TeacherActionReceiptEvidence struct {
	Schema                     string `json:"schema"`
	Kind                       string `json:"kind"`
	ActionReceiptID            string `json:"action_receipt_id"`
	SourcePromptMessageID      string `json:"source_prompt_message_id"`
	SourcePromptMessageVersion int    `json:"source_prompt_message_version"`
	BlockID                    string `json:"block_id"`
	ActionID                   string `json:"action_id"`
	SourceUIDigest             string `json:"source_ui_digest"`
}

// NormalizeTeacherActionReceiptEvidence applies the same bounded opaque-ID
// and lowercase SHA-256 digest rules as Dialog's private interaction type.
func NormalizeTeacherActionReceiptEvidence(input TeacherActionReceiptEvidence) (TeacherActionReceiptEvidence, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.Kind = strings.TrimSpace(input.Kind)
	input.ActionReceiptID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ActionReceiptID)
	input.SourcePromptMessageID = strings.TrimSpace(input.SourcePromptMessageID)
	input.BlockID = strings.TrimSpace(input.BlockID)
	input.ActionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ActionID)
	input.SourceUIDigest = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.SourceUIDigest))
	if input.Schema != TeacherActionReceiptEvidenceSchema || input.Kind != TeacherActionReceiptEvidenceKind ||
		!validUUID(input.ActionReceiptID) || !validUUID(input.SourcePromptMessageID) || input.SourcePromptMessageVersion < 1 ||
		!validTeacherActionReceiptOpaqueID(input.BlockID) || !validTeacherActionReceiptOpaqueID(input.ActionID) ||
		!validTeacherActionReceiptDigest(input.SourceUIDigest) {
		return TeacherActionReceiptEvidence{}, ErrInvalidTeacherTurnContract
	}
	return input, nil
}

func validTeacherActionReceiptOpaqueID(value string) bool {
	if value == "" || len(value) > MaxTeacherActionReceiptOpaqueIDLen {
		return false
	}
	for _, character := range []byte(value) {
		if (character < 'a' || character > 'z') && (character < 'A' || character > 'Z') &&
			(character < '0' || character > '9') && character != '.' && character != '_' &&
			character != '-' && character != ':' {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func validTeacherActionReceiptDigest(value string) bool {
	if len(value) != TeacherActionReceiptDigestHexLen {
		return false
	}
	for _, character := range []byte(value) {
		if (character < '0' || character > '9') && (character < 'a' || character > 'f') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// ValidateTeacherActionReceiptForJobTurn binds action evidence to the Teacher
// job turn without giving the receipt permission to mutate Student state.
func ValidateTeacherActionReceiptForJobTurn(evidence TeacherActionReceiptEvidence, correlation TeacherJobTurnCorrelation) error {
	normalizedEvidence, err := NormalizeTeacherActionReceiptEvidence(evidence)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	normalizedCorrelation, err := NormalizeTeacherJobTurnCorrelation(correlation)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if normalizedCorrelation.ActionReceiptID == "" || normalizedCorrelation.ActionReceiptID != normalizedEvidence.ActionReceiptID {
		return ErrInvalidTeacherTurnContract
	}
	return nil
}

// TeacherJobTurnCorrelation carries identity bindings at the Teacher-job
// intake boundary only. It does not impose one causation field across Dialog,
// Student, AI Prompt, and the eventual Teacher response; each downstream
// boundary defines and validates its own causation semantics.
// TeacherTurnSequence is Dialog-owned dense per-dialog ordering. The source
// message sequence is retained as evidence only; it is not the turn cursor.
type TeacherJobTurnCorrelation struct {
	SourceEventID             string `json:"source_event_id"`
	TeacherTurnSequence       int64  `json:"teacher_turn_sequence"`
	DialogID                  string `json:"dialog_id"`
	CanonicalStudentMessageID string `json:"canonical_student_message_id"`
	SourceMessageSequence     int64  `json:"source_message_sequence"`
	StudentID                 string `json:"student_id"`
	PersonalTeacherID         string `json:"personal_teacher_id"`
	TeacherJobID              string `json:"teacher_job_id,omitempty"`
	ActionReceiptID           string `json:"action_receipt_id,omitempty"`
	StudentCommandID          string `json:"student_command_id,omitempty"`
	AIExecutionID             string `json:"ai_execution_id,omitempty"`
	CorrelationID             string `json:"correlation_id"`
	CausationID               string `json:"causation_id"`
	LearningActionID          string `json:"learning_action_id,omitempty"`
}

func NormalizeTeacherJobTurnCorrelation(input TeacherJobTurnCorrelation) (TeacherJobTurnCorrelation, error) {
	input.SourceEventID = strings.TrimSpace(input.SourceEventID)
	input.DialogID = strings.TrimSpace(input.DialogID)
	input.CanonicalStudentMessageID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CanonicalStudentMessageID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.PersonalTeacherID = strings.TrimSpace(input.PersonalTeacherID)
	input.TeacherJobID = strings.TrimSpace(input.TeacherJobID)
	input.ActionReceiptID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ActionReceiptID)
	input.StudentCommandID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentCommandID)
	input.AIExecutionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.AIExecutionID)
	input.CorrelationID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CorrelationID)
	input.CausationID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CausationID)
	input.LearningActionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningActionID)
	if !validUUID(input.SourceEventID) || input.TeacherTurnSequence < 1 ||
		!validUUID(input.DialogID) || !validUUID(input.CanonicalStudentMessageID) ||
		input.SourceMessageSequence < 1 || !validUUID(input.StudentID) ||
		!validUUID(input.PersonalTeacherID) || !validUUID(input.CorrelationID) ||
		!validUUID(input.CausationID) || input.CausationID != input.SourceEventID ||
		!validOptionalTeacherJobTurnUUIDs(input) {
		return TeacherJobTurnCorrelation{}, ErrInvalidTeacherTurnContract
	}
	if input.ActionReceiptID != "" {
		if input.CorrelationID != input.ActionReceiptID {
			return TeacherJobTurnCorrelation{}, ErrInvalidTeacherTurnContract
		}
	} else if input.CorrelationID != input.CanonicalStudentMessageID {
		return TeacherJobTurnCorrelation{}, ErrInvalidTeacherTurnContract
	}
	return input, nil
}

func validOptionalTeacherJobTurnUUIDs(input TeacherJobTurnCorrelation) bool {
	for _, value := range []string{
		input.TeacherJobID, input.ActionReceiptID, input.StudentCommandID,
		input.AIExecutionID, input.LearningActionID,
	} {
		if value != "" && !validUUID(value) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// TeacherTurnOrder is the dense per-dialog ordering fence. Source message
// sequence is copied as evidence, but never determines eligibility.
type TeacherTurnOrder struct {
	DialogID              string `json:"dialog_id"`
	SourceEventID         string `json:"source_event_id"`
	TeacherTurnSequence   int64  `json:"teacher_turn_sequence"`
	SourceMessageSequence int64  `json:"source_message_sequence"`
}

func NormalizeTeacherTurnOrder(input TeacherTurnOrder) (TeacherTurnOrder, error) {
	input.DialogID = strings.TrimSpace(input.DialogID)
	input.SourceEventID = strings.TrimSpace(input.SourceEventID)
	if !validUUID(input.DialogID) || !validUUID(input.SourceEventID) ||
		input.TeacherTurnSequence < 1 || input.SourceMessageSequence < 1 {
		return TeacherTurnOrder{}, ErrInvalidTeacherTurnContract
	}
	return input, nil
}

// ValidateTeacherTurnOrder accepts only the next dense Dialog-owned turn.
// SourceMessageSequence is evidence and may contain gaps or differ from the
// dense turn sequence because replies and other Dialog messages share it.
func ValidateTeacherTurnOrder(previous *TeacherTurnOrder, current TeacherTurnOrder) error {
	normalizedCurrent, err := NormalizeTeacherTurnOrder(current)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if previous == nil {
		if normalizedCurrent.TeacherTurnSequence != 1 {
			return ErrTeacherTurnOutOfOrder
		}
		return nil
	}
	normalizedPrevious, err := NormalizeTeacherTurnOrder(*previous)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if normalizedCurrent.DialogID != normalizedPrevious.DialogID ||
		normalizedCurrent.TeacherTurnSequence != normalizedPrevious.TeacherTurnSequence+1 ||
		normalizedCurrent.SourceEventID == normalizedPrevious.SourceEventID {
		return ErrTeacherTurnOutOfOrder
	}
	return nil
}

// ValidateTeacherTurnEligibility rejects a later turn arriving before the
// expected dense sequence. This is the S0 invariant; it does not implement
// runtime scheduling or cursor persistence (those remain S1 work).
func ValidateTeacherTurnEligibility(expectedSequence int64, current TeacherTurnOrder) error {
	normalized, err := NormalizeTeacherTurnOrder(current)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if expectedSequence < 1 || normalized.TeacherTurnSequence != expectedSequence {
		return ErrTeacherTurnOutOfOrder
	}
	return nil
}

type TeacherTurnTerminalOutcome string

const (
	TeacherTurnDelivered      TeacherTurnTerminalOutcome = "delivered"
	TeacherTurnFailedNoEffect TeacherTurnTerminalOutcome = "failed_no_effect"
)

type TeacherTurnReconciliationState string

const (
	TeacherTurnUnknown               TeacherTurnReconciliationState = "unknown"
	TeacherTurnPartial               TeacherTurnReconciliationState = "partial"
	TeacherTurnCommittedUnreconciled TeacherTurnReconciliationState = "committed_unreconciled"
)

// TeacherTurnCursor is an S0 value object. Only delivered and proven
// failed_no_effect are terminal outcomes. Reconciliation states are blocking
// observations and can never advance a cursor.
type TeacherTurnCursor struct {
	Order                    TeacherTurnOrder               `json:"order"`
	Outcome                  TeacherTurnTerminalOutcome     `json:"outcome,omitempty"`
	ReconciliationState      TeacherTurnReconciliationState `json:"reconciliation_state,omitempty"`
	TeacherResponseMessageID string                         `json:"teacher_response_message_id,omitempty"`
	StudentCommandID         string                         `json:"student_command_id,omitempty"`
	NoEffectProofID          string                         `json:"no_effect_proof_id,omitempty"`
	RecoverableOutcomeID     string                         `json:"recoverable_outcome_id,omitempty"`
	FailureCode              string                         `json:"failure_code,omitempty"`
}

func NormalizeTeacherTurnCursor(input TeacherTurnCursor) (TeacherTurnCursor, error) {
	order, err := NormalizeTeacherTurnOrder(input.Order)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherTurnCursor{}, err
	}
	input.Order = order
	input.Outcome = TeacherTurnTerminalOutcome(strings.TrimSpace(string(input.Outcome)))
	input.ReconciliationState = TeacherTurnReconciliationState(strings.TrimSpace(string(input.ReconciliationState)))
	input.TeacherResponseMessageID = strings.TrimSpace(input.TeacherResponseMessageID)
	input.StudentCommandID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentCommandID)
	input.NoEffectProofID = strings.TrimSpace(input.NoEffectProofID)
	input.RecoverableOutcomeID = strings.TrimSpace(input.RecoverableOutcomeID)
	input.FailureCode = strings.TrimSpace(input.FailureCode)
	if input.TeacherResponseMessageID != "" && !validUUID(input.TeacherResponseMessageID) ||
		input.StudentCommandID != "" && !validUUID(input.StudentCommandID) ||
		input.NoEffectProofID != "" && !validUUID(input.NoEffectProofID) ||
		input.RecoverableOutcomeID != "" && !validUUID(input.RecoverableOutcomeID) ||
		len(input.FailureCode) > 64 {
		return TeacherTurnCursor{}, ErrInvalidTeacherTurnContract
	}
	if input.ReconciliationState != "" {
		if input.Outcome != "" || input.TeacherResponseMessageID != "" ||
			input.StudentCommandID != "" || input.NoEffectProofID != "" || input.RecoverableOutcomeID != "" || input.FailureCode != "" {
			return TeacherTurnCursor{}, ErrInvalidTeacherTurnContract
		}
		switch input.ReconciliationState {
		case TeacherTurnUnknown, TeacherTurnPartial, TeacherTurnCommittedUnreconciled:
			return input, nil
		default:
			return TeacherTurnCursor{}, ErrInvalidTeacherTurnContract
		}
	}
	switch input.Outcome {
	case TeacherTurnDelivered:
		// A Student command may be accepted, but it never advances without a
		// confirmed canonical Teacher reply.
		if !validUUID(input.TeacherResponseMessageID) || input.FailureCode != "" || input.RecoverableOutcomeID != "" {
			return TeacherTurnCursor{}, ErrInvalidTeacherTurnContract
		}
	case TeacherTurnFailedNoEffect:
		// No-effect is terminal only with proof of no committed Student effect,
		// no reply, a bounded failure code, and a durable linked recoverable
		// outcome. StudentCommandID is optional attempted-command evidence; its
		// presence does not imply a committed Student transition when the proof
		// is valid.
		if input.TeacherResponseMessageID != "" || !validUUID(input.NoEffectProofID) ||
			input.FailureCode == "" || !validUUID(input.RecoverableOutcomeID) {
			return TeacherTurnCursor{}, ErrInvalidTeacherTurnContract
		}
	default:
		return TeacherTurnCursor{}, ErrInvalidTeacherTurnContract
	}
	return input, nil
}

func (cursor TeacherTurnCursor) CanAdvance() bool {
	return cursor.ReconciliationState == "" &&
		(cursor.Outcome == TeacherTurnDelivered || cursor.Outcome == TeacherTurnFailedNoEffect)
}

// ValidateTeacherTurnCursorAdvance makes the terminal result and previous
// cursor safe before allowing a later dense turn to proceed.
func ValidateTeacherTurnCursorAdvance(previous *TeacherTurnCursor, current TeacherTurnCursor) error {
	normalizedCurrent, err := NormalizeTeacherTurnCursor(current)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !normalizedCurrent.CanAdvance() {
		return ErrTeacherTurnCursorBlocked
	}
	if previous == nil {
		return ValidateTeacherTurnEligibility(1, normalizedCurrent.Order)
	}
	normalizedPrevious, err := NormalizeTeacherTurnCursor(*previous)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !normalizedPrevious.CanAdvance() {
		return ErrTeacherTurnCursorBlocked
	}
	return ValidateTeacherTurnOrder(&normalizedPrevious.Order, normalizedCurrent.Order)
}

// TeacherStudentTransitionLedger records at most one accepted Student
// command for a logical turn. Repeating the same command is a replay; a
// different command is an integrity conflict.
type TeacherStudentTransitionLedger struct {
	SourceEventID             string `json:"source_event_id"`
	CanonicalStudentMessageID string `json:"canonical_student_message_id,omitempty"`
	ActionReceiptID           string `json:"action_receipt_id,omitempty"`
	StudentCommandID          string `json:"student_command_id,omitempty"`
}

func AcceptStudentTransition(ledger TeacherStudentTransitionLedger, sourceEventID, studentCommandID string) (TeacherStudentTransitionLedger, bool, error) {
	sourceEventID = strings.TrimSpace(sourceEventID)
	studentCommandID = strings.TrimSpace(studentCommandID)
	if !validUUID(sourceEventID) || !validUUID(studentCommandID) {
		return TeacherStudentTransitionLedger{}, false, ErrInvalidTeacherTurnContract
	}
	if ledger.SourceEventID == "" {
		ledger.SourceEventID = sourceEventID
	}
	if !validUUID(ledger.SourceEventID) || ledger.SourceEventID != sourceEventID {
		return TeacherStudentTransitionLedger{}, false, ErrInvalidTeacherTurnContract
	}
	if ledger.StudentCommandID == "" {
		ledger.StudentCommandID = studentCommandID
		return ledger, false, nil
	}
	if ledger.StudentCommandID == studentCommandID {
		return ledger, true, nil
	}
	return TeacherStudentTransitionLedger{}, false, ErrMultipleStudentTransitions
}

// TeacherReplyLedger makes the Dialog append identity explicit. A retry may
// replay the same committed message, but cannot introduce a second command or
// a different message for the same logical turn.
type TeacherReplyLedger struct {
	SourceEventID            string `json:"source_event_id"`
	TeacherJobID             string `json:"teacher_job_id"`
	DialogReplyCommandID     string `json:"dialog_reply_command_id"`
	TeacherResponseMessageID string `json:"teacher_response_message_id"`
}

func RecordTeacherReply(ledger TeacherReplyLedger, sourceEventID, teacherJobID, dialogReplyCommandID, messageID string) (TeacherReplyLedger, bool, error) {
	sourceEventID = strings.TrimSpace(sourceEventID)
	teacherJobID = strings.TrimSpace(teacherJobID)
	dialogReplyCommandID = strings.TrimSpace(dialogReplyCommandID)
	messageID = strings.TrimSpace(messageID)
	if !validUUID(sourceEventID) || !validUUID(teacherJobID) || !validUUID(dialogReplyCommandID) || !validUUID(messageID) {
		return TeacherReplyLedger{}, false, ErrInvalidTeacherTurnContract
	}
	if ledger.SourceEventID == "" {
		return TeacherReplyLedger{SourceEventID: sourceEventID, TeacherJobID: teacherJobID, DialogReplyCommandID: dialogReplyCommandID, TeacherResponseMessageID: messageID}, false, nil
	}
	if ledger.SourceEventID != sourceEventID || ledger.TeacherJobID != teacherJobID || ledger.DialogReplyCommandID != dialogReplyCommandID || ledger.TeacherResponseMessageID != messageID {
		return TeacherReplyLedger{}, false, ErrDuplicateTeacherReply
	}
	return ledger, true, nil
}

// TeacherTurnLLMContract is a boundary assertion for future S1 wiring:
// Teacher may call only AI Prompt and the model may return text, never a
// Student mutation command.
type TeacherTurnLLMContract struct {
	SourceEventID            string `json:"source_event_id"`
	TeacherJobID             string `json:"teacher_job_id"`
	AIExecutionID            string `json:"ai_execution_id"`
	Boundary                 string `json:"boundary"`
	TemplateCode             string `json:"template_code"`
	ResponseSchemaCode       string `json:"response_schema_code"`
	StudentMutationRequested bool   `json:"student_mutation_requested"`
}

func NormalizeTeacherTurnLLMContract(input TeacherTurnLLMContract) (TeacherTurnLLMContract, error) {
	input.SourceEventID = strings.TrimSpace(input.SourceEventID)
	input.TeacherJobID = strings.TrimSpace(input.TeacherJobID)
	input.AIExecutionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.AIExecutionID)
	input.Boundary = strings.TrimSpace(input.Boundary)
	input.TemplateCode = strings.TrimSpace(input.TemplateCode)
	input.ResponseSchemaCode = strings.TrimSpace(input.ResponseSchemaCode)
	if !validUUID(input.SourceEventID) || !validUUID(input.TeacherJobID) || !validUUID(input.AIExecutionID) ||
		input.Boundary != TeacherTurnLLMBoundary || input.TemplateCode != TeacherResponseTemplateCode ||
		input.ResponseSchemaCode != TeacherResponseSchemaCode || input.StudentMutationRequested {
		return TeacherTurnLLMContract{}, ErrInvalidTeacherTurnContract
	}
	return input, nil
}
